div.div: Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Media completion and evidence/indexing are separate Content-owned stages: SOURCE_VIDEO persists validated HLS/thumbnail and queues an evidence job; EXISTING_HLS evidence preserves source metadata before indexing. Inactive candidates and accepted evidence remain distinct datasets; checkpoint, resume, activation and rollback are sequences 29–31.
